.lab { margin: 20px 0 10px; border: 2px solid var(--line); border-radius: 16px; background: var(--surface); overflow: hidden; }

<div class="skyband">
<header class="hero wrap">

    <div>
      <div class="eyebrow"><b>Lernpfad</b> Informatik</div>
      <h1>Vogelflug</h1>
      <p class="lead">Ein kleiner Vogel will über den ganzen Himmel fliegen. Drei Flügelschläge schafft er schon. Heute bringst du ihm bei, so lange weiterzufliegen, bis er am Ziel ist.</p>
      <ul class="goals">

        <li>Mit der <code>while</code>-Schleife Anweisungen wiederholen</li>
        <li>Endlosschleifen erkennen und vermeiden</li>

  const KW = new Set(["class","new","void","return","if","else","while","for","true","false","null","this","extends","super","public","private"]);
  const esc = s => s.replace(/&/g,"&").replace(/</g,"<").replace(/>/g,">");
  function hl(line) {
    const re = /(\/\/.*$|\/\*.*$|^\s*\*.*$)|("(?:[^"\\]|\\.)*")|(\b\d+(?:\.\d+)?\b)|([A-Za-z_äöüÄÖÜß]\w*)|(\s+)|([^\sA-Za-z_\d"]+)/g;
    let out = "", m;
    while ((m = re.exec(line))) {
      if (m[1]) out += `<span class="t-com">${esc(m[1])}</span>`;
      else if (m[2]) out += `<span class="t-str">${esc(m[2])}</span>`;
      else if (m[3]) out += `<span class="t-num">${m[3]}</span>`;
      else if (m[4]) {
        const w = m[4], rest = line.slice(re.lastIndex);
        if (KW.has(w)) out += `<span class="t-kw">${w}</span>`;
        else if (/^\s*\(/.test(rest) && !/^[A-Z]/.test(w)) out += `<span class="t-fn">${w}</span>`;
        else if (/^[A-Z]/.test(w)) out += `<span class="t-ty">${w}</span>`;
        else out += w;
      } else out += esc(m[0]);
    }
    return out;
  }
  const lines = src => src.split("\n").map((l, i) => `<span class="ln" data-n="${i + 1}">${hl(l) || " "}</span>`).join("");

  // ---------- Codekästen ----------
  const copyIcon = '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><rect x="9" y="9" width="12" height="12" rx="2"/><path d="M5 15V5a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h10"/></svg>';
  async function copyText(text, btn, target) {
    let ok = false;
    try { await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text); ok = true; } catch (e) { }
    if (!ok && target) {
      const r = document.createRange(); r.selectNodeContents(target);
      const sel = getSelection(); sel.removeAllRanges(); sel.addRange(r);
      try { ok = document.execCommand("copy"); } catch (e) { }
    }
    const label = btn.querySelector("span"), old = label.textContent;
    label.textContent = ok ? "Kopiert" : "Markiert – jetzt kopieren";
    btn.classList.add("is-copied");
    setTimeout(() => { label.textContent = old; btn.classList.remove("is-copied"); }, 1800);
  }
  document.querySelectorAll(".code[data-src]").forEach(box => {
    const src = SRC[box.dataset.src];
    const copy = box.hasAttribute("data-nocopy") ? "" : `<button class="copy" type="button">${copyIcon}<span>Kopieren</span></button>`;
    box.innerHTML = `<div class="code-head"><span class="fname">${esc(box.dataset.file)}</span>${copy}</div><pre>${lines(src)}</pre>`;
    const btn = box.querySelector(".copy");
    if (btn) btn.addEventListener("click", () => copyText(src, btn, box.querySelector("pre")));
  });

  const stations = [...document.querySelectorAll(".station")];
  const stops = document.getElementById("trailStops");
  stops.innerHTML = stations.map(s => `<a href="#${s.id}" data-stop="${s.dataset.station}"${s.dataset.unlock ? ' class="is-bonus" hidden' : ""} aria-label="Station ${s.dataset.station}: ${esc(s.querySelector("h2").textContent)}">${s.dataset.station}</a>`).join("");
  let firstRender = true;
  function renderProgress() {
    let n = 0;
    // Bonus-Station erst zeigen, wenn die Station davor abgehakt ist

      if (!s.dataset.unlock) return;
      const open = !!done[s.dataset.unlock], was = !s.classList.contains("is-locked");

      stops.querySelector(`[data-stop="${s.dataset.station}"]`).hidden = !open;
      if (open && !was && !firstRender) { s.classList.add("is-new"); setTimeout(() => s.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "start" }), 250); }
    });
    firstRender = false;
    const visible = stations.filter(s => !s.classList.contains("is-locked"));
    stations.forEach(s => {
      const id = s.dataset.station, d = !!done[id];
      if (d) n++;
      stops.querySelector(`[data-stop="${id}"]`).classList.toggle("is-done", d);
      const cb = s.querySelector(`[data-done="${id}"]`); if (cb) cb.checked = d;
    });
    n = visible.filter(s => done[s.dataset.station]).length;
    document.getElementById("trailCount").textContent = `${n} / ${visible.length}`;
  }
  document.querySelectorAll("[data-done]").forEach(cb => cb.addEventListener("change", () => {
    done[cb.dataset.done] = cb.checked;

    renderProgress();

  function applyZoom() {
    document.documentElement.style.setProperty("--fz", String(STEPS[zi]));

  }

    const bar = document.querySelector(".trail").getBoundingClientRect().bottom;
    const cur = stations.filter(st => st.getBoundingClientRect().top <= bar + 1).pop();
    const r0 = cur ? cur.getBoundingClientRect() : null;
    const frac = r0 && r0.height > 0 ? (bar - r0.top) / r0.height : 0;
    zi = Math.max(0, Math.min(STEPS.length - 1, zi + Number(b.dataset.fs)));
    try { localStorage.setItem(FS_KEY, String(STEPS[zi])); } catch (e) { }
    applyZoom();
    if (cur) requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      const r1 = cur.getBoundingClientRect();

  (function () {
    const root = document.getElementById("whileLab");

    const condEl = root.querySelector("[data-role=cond]"), outEl = root.querySelector("[data-role=out]"), say = root.querySelector("[data-role=say]");
    const back = root.querySelector("[data-act=back]"), next = root.querySelector("[data-act=next]");
    codeEl.innerHTML = `<pre>${lines(SRC.piep)}</pre>`;
    // Zustände erzeugen: Zeile, i, Bedingung, Ausgabe, Erklärung

    i = 1; st.push({ line: 1, i, cond: null, out: [], say: "<code>Integer i = 1;</code> legt die Zählvariable an. Sie zählt mit, wie oft schon gepiept wurde." });
    let round = 0;
    while (true) {
      const ok = i <= 3;
      st.push({ line: 2, i, cond: [i, ok], out: [...out], say: ok ? `Die Bedingung <code>${i} <= 3</code> ist <b>wahr</b>. Also geht es in den Rumpf.` : `Die Bedingung <code>${i} <= 3</code> ist <b>falsch</b>. Die Schleife ist zu Ende, der Rumpf wird übersprungen.` });
      if (!ok) break;
      round++;
      out.push("Piep " + i);
      st.push({ line: 3, i, cond: [i, ok], out: [...out], say: `Ausgabe: „Piep ${i}“. Das ist Runde ${round}.` });
      i = i + 1;
      st.push({ line: 4, i, cond: [i - 1, ok], out: [...out], say: `<code>i = i + 1;</code> Aus ${i - 1} wird ${i}.`, flash: true });
      st.push({ line: 5, i, cond: [i - 1, ok], out: [...out], say: "Die schließende Klammer schickt das Programm <b>zurück zur Bedingung</b>." });
    }
    out.push("Fertig!");
    st.push({ line: 6, i, cond: [i, false], out: [...out], say: "Nach der Schleife geht es ganz normal weiter. Die Bedingung wurde viermal geprüft: dreimal wahr, einmal falsch." });
    let k = 0;
    function render() {
      const s = st[k];
      codeEl.querySelectorAll(".ln").forEach(el => el.classList.toggle("is-next", +el.dataset.n == s.line));
      iEl.textContent = s.i == null ? "–" : s.i;
      iEl.classList.toggle("is-flash", !!s.flash);
      if (s.flash) { void iEl.offsetWidth; }
      if (!s.cond) { condEl.className = "cond"; condEl.textContent = "noch nicht geprüft"; }
      else { condEl.className = "cond " + (s.cond[1] ? "is-true" : "is-false"); condEl.textContent = `${s.cond[0]} <= 3  →  ${s.cond[1] ? "wahr" : "falsch"}`; }
      outEl.textContent = s.out.join("\n");
      say.innerHTML = s.say;
      back.disabled = k == 0; next.disabled = k == st.length - 1;
    }
    next.addEventListener("click", () => { if (k < st.length - 1) { k++; render(); } });
    back.addEventListener("click", () => { if (k > 0) { k--; render(); } });
    root.querySelector("[data-act=reset]").addEventListener("click", () => { k = 0; render(); });
    render();
  })();
